blocks.text: Condo buildings in Annieville
Delta Cedars — 8635 120 Street

Built 1973, 96 units (building directory, secondary source). The directory records restrictions as: age restrictions, pets not allowed, rentals not allowed — the rental line is void since November 24, 2022, and the age line is only enforceable if it is a 55+ bylaw. Directory amenities: elevator, outdoor pool, recreation centre, sauna/steam room, shared laundry, storage. Year-built conflict: several current MLS listings give 1972 for individual units while the directory gives 1973 — treat the exact year as 1972/1973, sources differ. Listings describe wood-frame construction with a mixed exterior, a clubhouse, an outdoor pool and heat/hot water among the amenities for one unit.
Muse North Delta ("Muse") — 9015 120 Street

A mixed complex: the building directory's unit variants include 1-, 2- and 3-bedroom apartments and townhouses, and current listings confirm both forms at this address — apartment units (for example unit 309, listed as Apartment, and unit 519, listed as Apartment) and townhouse units (for example unit 104, listed as a townhouse). The directory records restrictions as: pets allowed with restrictions, rentals allowed. Directory amenities: club house, elevator, exercise centre, garden, in-suite laundry, storage. Year-built conflict: the directory states built 2017, while multiple current MLS listings state built 2019.
Streets, schools and getting around Annieville

items.t: Annieville is in north-west North Delta in the City of Delta, along the Fraser River frontage; the former North Delta Area Plan map shows Annieville along River Road, with 116 Street at its east side and the Fraser River at its north side, and the City publishes no street-by-street written boundary.
Where the condo stock concentrates: the Scott Road (120 Street) east edge, in two buildings only — Delta Cedars at 8635 120 Street and Muse North Delta at 9015 120 Street.
Transit from the Scott Road buildings: routes 312 and 391 both connect the area to Scott Road Station on the Expo Line — the 312 via 112 Street and the 391 via 116 Street.

blocks.text: Good to know about Annieville

items.t: Delta Cedars' listings disagree with its directory on the build year: the directory says 1973; several 2026 unit listings say 1972. On a building this age the one-year difference changes nothing about due diligence — the depreciation report and Form B matter, not the marketing year.

Delta Cedars carries the full 1970s amenity set: the directory lists an elevator, outdoor pool, recreation centre, sauna/steam room, shared laundry and storage — shared laundry (not in-suite) is a real daily-life difference from Muse, whose directory lists in-suite laundry.

The River Road infill pattern is the area's other housing story: a City bylaw notice for 10604 River Road proposed rezoning from RD3 to RS6 for a two-lot subdivision under Bylaw No. 7600 — large river-side lots splitting into small lots is how Annieville adds homes, not condo buildings.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Annieville
MLS listings and the building directory classify both as Annieville.
Streets, schools and getting around Annieville

items.t: Main roads: River Road along the river frontage; 112 Street and 116 Street running south to Nordel Way and Highway 91 / Alex Fraser Bridge access; Scott Road (120 Street) to the east.

Where the townhouse stock concentrates: the Scott Road east edge — the townhouse units inside the mixed Muse complex at 9015 120 Street, and the Delta Gardens townhouses at 8447 115 Street by the 84 Avenue corner.

Transit: routes 312 and 391 both connect the area to Scott Road Station on the Expo Line — the 312 via Scott Road, 96 Avenue, 114 Street, 92A Avenue, 112 Street and 72 Avenue, and the 391 via 72 Avenue, 116 Street and 96 Avenue.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Annieville

items.t: Strata vs fee-simple — the core distinction: both Annieville townhouse complexes are strata. A strata townhouse buyer owns a strata lot, pays strata fees, and gets a Form B package. A fee-simple townhouse buyer owns the lot outright: no strata, no Form B, no strata fees — municipal rules and any registered covenants/HOA only.

blocks.text: Good to know about Annieville

items.t: One complex, three sub-areas: Delta Gardens is classified Nordel, Scottsdale and Annieville across different listings for the same development — the apartment building at 11501 84 Avenue in one feed, the townhouses at 8447 115 Street in another. Search all three names or you will miss half the resales.

The nearest library is technically in the next sub-area: George Mackie Library (Fraser Valley Regional Library), 8440 112th Street, is just east in Nordel, and the North Delta Recreation Centre at 11415 84 Avenue serves North Delta from Nordel — the Delta Gardens townhouse listing itself markets a 1-minute walk to that recreation centre.

blocks.text: Annieville home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

18 condos sold in Annieville with a median price of $428,500 (the middle half sold between $336,250 and $511,225), taking a median of 16 days to sell at 97.0% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $423 per square foot, a median year built of 1986 and a median strata fee of $431 a month. 5 townhomes sold in Annieville with a median price of $725,000, taking a median of 21 days to sell at 98.1% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $419 per square foot, a median year built of 1991 and a median strata fee of $305 a month.
